steps.label: Federal Convention convened
steps.quote: The Federal Convention convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787

steps.label: adjourned from day to day
steps.quote: the members adjourned from day to day until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25

steps.label: discussion and debate
steps.quote: Through discussion and debate it became clear by mid-June that, rather than amend the existing Articles

steps.label: debated, and redrafted
steps.quote: All through the summer, in closed sessions, the delegates debated, and redrafted the articles of the new Constitution.

steps.label: chief points at issue
steps.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government

steps.label: art of compromise
steps.quote: The work of many minds, the Constitution stands as a model of cooperative statesmanship and the art of compromise.
